东海老人身死
竹林里，隋缘走在石阶上，想到刚才陈倩那好像要杀了自己的模样，心中仍有些后怕。
打定主意，如果没什么必要，自己以后绝对不单独和那女人呆在一起。
再次来到上午的树荫下，隋缘有些无聊的盘坐下来，看着码头上来来往往的身影，心思却不知道飞去了哪里。
日出日落之中，英雄大会召开的时间临近，隋缘在竹楼内吃过了晚饭便准备直接休息了，明天就是英雄大会召开的日子，他准备一早先去石亭那里看过石镜映霞后直接去英雄大会。
不知是不是心中有愧，还是被李素给教育了，陈倩这两天一只呆在房间里面没有出来，就连饭食都是李素送进去的。
任谁看不见那个想要杀掉自己的人心里面都会非常高兴的，隋缘也乐见其成。
一夜无话，第二天天未亮隋缘便起身，在院子的小水潭里洗了一把脸后便径直向石亭处走去。
这两天隋缘每天都会去石壁那里看景，路径早已经熟悉。
等隋缘来到的时候，石亭里里外外已经站满了人，隋缘在边缘处找了一处空地站定，抬眼看向石壁。
就像是巧合一般，几乎在隋缘目光落在石壁上的同时，原本幽深的石壁中央忽然亮起了一抹金光。
隋缘对此已经有些习惯，微微眯起了双眼，仍旧盯着石壁。
随着石壁上金光亮起，原本的幽深缓缓的褪去，金光如海浪一般层层叠叠的向周围涤荡而去。
再次目睹这样的奇观，隋缘心中仍旧十分的感慨。
等到石亭中的人都走的差不多了，隋缘才迈步向山下的小镇走去。
照例在小摊子上买了两个馒头，隋缘边吃边向英雄会的场地走去。
今天镇子上的江湖人明显比前两天多了很多，走在街上可以听到带着各地口音的人在互相打着招呼。
很快，隋缘吃完了手中的馒头，英雄会的场地也出现在眼前。
此时已经有人在场地周围等着了。

目光从场地周围的桌椅上扫过，隋缘很识趣的没有去那些区域，来到附近一个地势稍高的地方，抬眼看向一旁遮荫的小树，隋缘点了点头，很是满意这个位置。
时间流逝，随着太阳越来越高，会场上的人也越来越多。
等会场周围的座椅快要被占满的时候，聂鹏带着李素与陈倩两人走了过来。
隋缘目光从陈倩身上扫过，眉梢微微挑了挑。
聂鹏几人在仆役的带领下，来到靠近会场中央的一排座椅前坐下，隋缘见状撇了撇嘴，扭过头不去理会。
聂鹏来后不久，陆续又有几波人赶来，隋缘还看到了定海城漕帮的张家公子。
随着时间一点点过去，场地周围，那些能占到座椅的几大势力面色也都有些不好看了起来。
东海老人召开这东海英雄会，这些人渡海而来本就已经给了他天大的面子，如今却让自己等在这里，有些脾气不好的已经开始向周围的仆役摆脸色了。
就在众人开始交头接耳的时候，有人快步走来，在聂鹏的身后耳语了几句。
隋缘只见聂鹏像是听到什么不可思议的事情一般，猛地从座椅上站了起来，跟着那仆役快步离开了会场。
不止聂鹏，会场周围那些有些名头的势力几乎都是如此。
眼见得那些大势力如此奇怪，会场周围的议论之声越发的大了。
“东海老人死了。”
不止是谁喊了一声，会场周围先是一静，众人面面相觑了起来，随后就像是海浪爆发一般，整个会场都陷入了慌乱之中。
东海老人在江湖上名头不小，不仅是因为他的交游广阔，他本人更是江湖上有数的高手，这样一个人在自己召开英雄会的时候被杀，怎么看都不同寻常。
小树树荫下，隋缘同样惊讶的站了起来，看向聂鹏等人离开的方向，想了想，迈步跟了上去。
沿着一条石板小路七拐八拐，隋缘很快来到一座位于半山腰的竹楼前，相比于聂鹏居住的那座，这里的竹楼占地要大了很多，竹楼周围的院子也大了很多。
隋缘只是在竹楼外围匆匆的一瞥，目光看向竹楼二楼，透过窗子上的缝隙，隋缘看到聂鹏与那定海城的张公子几人正围在那里，面色都有些难看。
“你们就住在附近，昨夜没有听到半点动静！
？”

目光扫过躺在床上的枯瘦老者，聂鹏面色阴沉的向一旁的中年汉子问道。
中年汉子名为谷山，乃是东海老人的三弟子，常年服侍在东海老人身旁。
“没有，”
谷山面色黯然的说到，“昨夜师傅休息的很早，一直到今天早上，我见师傅一直没有下来用膳，上楼来看的时候师傅就已经被害了。”

The old man of Donghai died
In the bamboo forest, Sui Yuan was walking on the stone steps. Thinking of Chen Qian's look as if she was about to kill him just now, he still felt a little scared.
Make up your mind that if there is no need, you will never stay alone with that woman in the future.
Coming under the shade of the trees in the morning again, Sui Yuan sat down cross-legged with some boredom, watching the figures coming and going on the pier, but his thoughts flew to nowhere.
As the sun rose and set, the time for the Heroes Conference was approaching. Sui Yuan had dinner in the bamboo building and was ready to go to bed directly. Tomorrow was the day when the Heroes Conference was held. He planned to go to Shiting early in the morning to see Shi Jing Yingxia and then go directly to the Heroes Conference.
I don't know if she felt guilty or was taught by Li Su. Chen Qian stayed in the room for the past two days and did not come out. Even the meals were sent in by Li Su.
Anyone who cannot see the person who wants to kill him will be very happy, and Sui Yuan is also happy to see it happen.
After a night of silence, Sui Yuan got up before dawn the next day, washed his face in the small pool in the yard, and then walked straight to the stone pavilion.
In the past two days, Sui Yuan would go to the stone wall to see the scenery every day, and the path was already familiar to him.
When Sui Yuan arrived, people were already standing inside and outside the stone pavilion. Sui Yuan found an open space at the edge and stood there, looking up at the stone wall.
Like a coincidence, almost at the same time Sui Yuan's eyes fell on the stone wall, a golden light suddenly lit up in the center of the originally deep stone wall.
Sui Yuan was somewhat used to this, so he narrowed his eyes slightly and still stared at the stone wall.
As the golden light on the stone wall lit up, the original depth slowly faded away, and the golden light washed away in layers like ocean waves.
Witnessing such a spectacle again, Sui Yuan was still very emotional.
After everyone in the stone pavilion had almost left, Sui Yuan walked towards the small town at the foot of the mountain.
As usual, Sui Yuan bought two steamed buns from a small stall. While eating, Sui Yuan walked towards the venue of the Heroes Association.
There are obviously many more people in the town today than there were two days ago. When walking on the street, you can hear people with accents from various places saying hello to each other.
Soon, Sui Yuan finished the steamed bun in his hand, and the venue of the Heroes Association appeared in front of him.
At this time, there were already people waiting around the venue.
Scanning his eyes from the tables and chairs around the venue, Sui Yuan wisely did not go to those areas. He came to a nearby place on a slightly higher ground and looked up at the small shading tree on the side. Sui Yuan nodded, very satisfied with this location.
Time passed, and as the sun got higher and higher, there were more and more people at the venue.
When the seats around the venue were almost occupied, Nie Peng came over with Li Su and Chen Qian.
Sui Yuan glanced at Chen Qian and raised his eyebrows slightly.
Nie Peng and others were led by servants to a row of seats near the center of the venue and sat down. Sui Yuan curled his lips and turned his head away.
Not long after Nie Peng arrived, several more waves of people arrived one after another. Sui Yuan also saw Young Master Zhang from the Cao Gang in Dinghai City.
As time passed by, the faces of the major forces occupying the seats around the venue began to look a little ugly.
The old man of the East China Sea convened the East China Sea Heroes Meeting. These people who crossed the sea had already given him great face, but now they made him wait here. Some of the bad-tempered ones had already begun to show off to the servants around them.
Just when everyone started whispering to each other, someone walked quickly and whispered a few words behind Nie Peng.
Sui Yuan saw Nie Peng suddenly stand up from his seat as if he heard something incredible, and quickly left the venue with the servant.
Not only Nie Peng, but almost all the famous forces around the venue were like this.
Seeing how strange those big forces were, the discussion around the venue became louder and louder.
"Old man Donghai is dead."
Not only did someone shout, but there was silence around the venue., everyone looked at each other, and then it was like a wave erupting, and the entire venue fell into panic.
Old Man Donghai is well-known in the world, not only because of his wide network of friends, but also because he is one of the most skilled masters in the world. It is unusual for such a person to be killed when he was convening a hero meeting.
Under the shade of a small tree, Sui Yuan stood up in surprise, looked towards the direction Nie Peng and others left, thought for a moment, and followed them.
Following a stone path, Sui Yuan quickly came to a bamboo building halfway up the mountain. Compared with the one where Nie Peng lived, the bamboo building here occupied a much larger area, and the yard around the bamboo building was also much larger.
Sui Yuan just glanced around the outside of the bamboo building and looked towards the second floor of the bamboo building. Through the gap in the window, Sui Yuan saw Nie Peng and Mr. Zhang from Dinghai City surrounding them, with ugly expressions on their faces.
"You live nearby and didn't hear any sound last night!
? "
Looking at the skinny old man lying on the bed, Nie Peng asked the middle-aged man beside him with a gloomy expression.
The middle-aged man named Gu Shan is the third disciple of Old Man Donghai, and he has been serving Old Man Donghai all year round.
"No,"
Gu Shan said with a sad expression, "Master went to bed very early last night. Until this morning, I saw that master had not come down to eat. When I went upstairs to see him, he had already been killed."
